loadFailed: Your settings could not be loaded. Close the settings and try again.
saveFailed: The last change could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.secureStorage: Your system's secure storage is not available or access was refused.
errors.io: The file could not be read or written. Check the location and try again.
errors.invalidInput: That did not work: the file or password is not valid.
errors.notFound: The file or item could not be found.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

identity.exportPasswordHint: Choose a password to protect the file. You need it to import the identity again.
identity.intro: An identity is a certificate in your system's secure storage. Servers recognise you by it. Use one everywhere, or pick a different one per server.
identity.createIntro: Mumcord creates a new certificate. The name on servers is what others see as your user name.
identity.name: Name on servers
identity.nameHint: The name inside the certificate, e.g. your first name. You can register another name on each server later.
identity.label: Label
identity.labelHint: Only shown in Mumcord, to tell your identities apart.
identity.importIntro: Choose a PKCS#12 file and enter its password. Files exported by the official Mumble client work as they are.
identity.notUsed: Not used by any server yet
identity.renameIntro: Only the label in Mumcord changes. The certificate and everything servers know about it stay the same.
identity.deleteWarning: Without a backup, the names and permissions registered with this identity on servers are lost. This cannot be undone.
identity.lastIdentity: Mumcord needs at least one identity. Create another one before you delete this one.
identity.typeToConfirm: Type the identity label to confirm
identity.backupWarning: Back up before you delete. An identity without a backup cannot be recovered.
identity.deleteUsedBy: These servers will use the default identity {{identity}} afterwards: {{servers}}

audio.testHint: Speak for a few seconds. Your voice is recorded with noise suppression applied and then played back to you.
audio.musicQualityHint: Tunes the encoder for music and turns off noise suppression and automatic volume; for music. Push-to-talk works best.
audio.bitrateMaxKnown: Maximum: {{kbps}} kbit/s. Loss on the connection can still lower it.
audio.bitrateMaxUnknown: Maximum: depends on server. Loss on the connection can still lower it.
audio.ducking: Lower video sound while people talk
audio.duckingHint: The watch-party video and screen-share sound get quieter while someone in your voice channel talks.
audio.lowLatencyHint: For playing music together in real time
audio.lowLatencyWifi: May glitch on Wi-Fi or a busy connection; use a cable if you can.
audio.lowLatencyHeadphones: Use headphones: echo cancellation is off (noise suppression and automatic volume are off too).
audio.lowLatencyPtt: Push-to-talk or a manual voice-activation threshold is recommended.

voice.talkModeLegend: How do you want to talk?
voice.voiceActivation: Voice activation – sends when you speak
voice.pushToTalk: Push-to-talk – sends while you hold a key

unavailable.waylandNoPortal: Push-to-talk is not available: your desktop does not offer global shortcuts.
unavailable.registrationFailed: Push-to-talk is not available: the shortcut could not be registered.
unavailable.mouseDisabled: Push-to-talk is not available: your mouse button needs "Allow mouse buttons" to be switched on.
unavailable.mouseNeedsInputGroup: Push-to-talk is not available: Mumcord may not read your mouse yet (see below).
unavailable.mouseNeedsAccessibility: Push-to-talk is not available: Mumcord needs the Accessibility permission to see mouse buttons.

voice.keyWaiting: Confirm the shortcut in your desktop's dialog or assign it in the System Settings window that opens…
voice.keyMissing: Set a key, otherwise nobody can hear you.
voice.keyRejected: That key cannot be used. Try another key, optionally with Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
voice.keyNotConfirmed: The desktop didn't confirm the shortcut. Try again and accept the system dialog, or assign the key in the desktop's shortcut settings.
voice.noiseSuppressionHint: Filters out background noise like keyboards and fans.

noiseChoiceHint.light: Classic filter for steady noise such as fans or hum. Lowest CPU use.
noiseChoiceHint.standard: AI filter for everyday noise such as keyboards and fans. Low CPU use.
noiseChoiceHint.advanced: Newer AI model that also removes changing noise. About three times the CPU of Standard and 10 ms more delay.

voice.detectorHint: Voice activation detects speech with the RNNoise model; it does not change your audio.
voice.echoCancellationHint: Stops others from hearing themselves when you use speakers.
voice.connectMuted: Connect muted until I join a channel
voice.connectMutedHint: When off, you connect with your last mute and deafen setting right away instead of listening only.
voice.autoGainHint: Keeps your voice at an even level.
voice.keyListeningMouse: Press a key or a mouse button (middle or side)… (Escape to cancel)
voice.mouseToggleWarning: Lets you use a mouse button for push-to-talk. For this you must be in the "input" group, which lets every program you run read all input devices, including your keyboard. Mumcord itself only opens mice, only watches your push-to-talk button and never records or logs anything.
voice.mouseInputGroup: Mumcord may not read your mouse yet. Add yourself to the "input" group by running this command in a terminal:
voice.mouseLogOut: Then log out and back in. Until then, use a keyboard key or voice activation.
voice.mouseNoDevice: No mouse found. Plug one in; Mumcord picks it up automatically.
voice.mouseAccessibility: To use mouse buttons, allow Mumcord under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then restart Mumcord.
voice.compatModeHint: Mumcord runs through your desktop's X11 compatibility layer, so push-to-talk works without a desktop dialog and without the "input" group. Your desktop decides what Mumcord may see: on KDE under System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support. By default only key combinations and modifier keys work; mouse buttons only if you allow them there. This is less isolated than the modern way.
voice.compatRestartNeeded: Takes effect after Mumcord restarts. You will be disconnected briefly.
voice.compatRestartFailed: Mumcord could not restart. Please close and open it yourself.
voice.compatKdeHint: Mouse buttons for push-to-talk only work while Mumcord is in the background if KDE allows them for X11 apps.
voice.compatKdeAllowed: KDE already allows mouse buttons for X11 apps, so the push-to-talk mouse button also works in the background.
voice.compatKdeRestart: Done. Restart Mumcord for it to take effect.
voice.compatKdeConfirm: This lets X11 apps running in the background see your mouse button presses. It changes a setting in KDE (System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support). You can undo it here at any time.
voice.compatKdeChangeFailed: Mumcord could not change the KDE setting. Use "Open KDE X11 settings" instead.
voice.compatKdeFailed: Mumcord could not open the KDE settings. Open System Settings → Legacy X11 App Support yourself.
voice.compatActive: Compatibility mode is on: push-to-talk uses the X11 way. Keys work without a desktop dialog; mouse buttons work if your desktop's legacy X11 setting allows them.
voice.manual: Manual threshold – sends above a level you set
voice.thresholdHint: Drag the slider over the meter. Mumcord sends while the level is above the line, plus a short moment after.

whisper.title: Whisper and shout targets
whisper.empty: No targets yet. Create one here, or with “Whisper to…” in the menu of a person or channel.
whisper.hint: Hold the key to talk to the target. Release it to go back to your channel. Works on any Mumble server.
whisper.name: Name
whisper.peopleHint: Pick one or more users on this server
whisper.channelHint: Talk to everyone in a channel without moving there
whisper.groupHint: A group defined on the server, e.g. admin. The server decides who belongs to it.
whisper.noPeople: Nobody else is on this server right now.
whisper.noServer: Connect to a server to pick people or a channel.
whisper.keyTaken: This key cannot be used: it is not a single key with optional modifiers, or it is already push-to-talk or another target's key.
whisper.keyFailed: This key is held by another app, so it does not work right now.
whisper.keysWayland: Whisper keys are not available in this Wayland session: the desktop's global shortcut portal only holds the push-to-talk key. Turn on the compatibility mode to use them, or start whispering from the user panel.
whisper.receiversMissing: Pick at least one person or a channel.

history.explanation: Chat messages are saved only on this computer.
history.confirmServer: All saved messages from {{server}} will be deleted from this computer. Other people keep their copies. Their copies won't be synced back to this computer. This cannot be undone.
history.confirmAll: All saved messages from every server will be deleted from this computer. Other people keep their copies. Their copies won't be synced back to this computer. This cannot be undone.
history.autoDeleteHint: Older messages are deleted from this computer automatically, without asking. This only affects the history saved here, not the server.

fullImages.title: Full-size images
fullImages.offerHint: Other Mumcord users can open my pictures in full size. Off: only the small preview is sent, no original is kept and none is shared.
fullImages.loadHint: Open pictures from other Mumcord users in full size. Off: only the preview is shown and the original is never requested.

historySharing.title: History sync
historySharing.hint: Other Mumcord users who join or follow a channel can fetch its messages from your saved history (up to 7 days, only from before they joined). Private chats are never shared.

appearance.cozy: Cozy: avatars, names above the messages
appearance.compact: Compact: time, name and message on one line
appearance.closeLegend: When you close the window while connected
appearance.autostart: Start Mumcord when I log in
appearance.startMinimizedHint: When Mumcord starts at login, it waits in the tray instead of opening the window.

themeEditor.name: Theme name
themeEditor.generatedFromDark: Made automatically from the dark version. It follows your changes there until you change it here.
themeEditor.generatedFromLight: Made automatically from the light version. It follows your changes there until you change it here.
themeEditor.invalidHex: Enter the colour as # followed by six hex digits, for example #1a2b3c.
themeEditor.contrastLowIn: {{version}}: contrast too low: {{ratio}}:1, needs at least {{min}}:1.
themeEditor.unreadable: This theme isn't readable enough. Change the text or background colour to save it.
themeEditor.shared: Theme copied. Paste it into a chat to share it.
themeEditor.shareFailed: Mumcord couldn't copy the theme to the clipboard.
themeEditor.importHint: Paste a chat message with a Mumcord theme, or just its code (it starts with mct1.).
themeEditor.importInvalid: This isn't a valid Mumcord theme.
themeEditor.madeWithNewer: Made with Mumcord {{version}} – update to see it fully.
themeEditor.deleteMessage: Servers that use this theme go back to the app theme.

accessibility.keyboardHintsHint: Short on-screen tips like “Arrow keys: move” below the channel list and in the GIF favorites. Screen readers still read them when this is off.
accessibility.announcementsHint: Your screen reader reads out events such as people joining, leaving or starting to talk.
accessibility.skipLinksHint: Links at the start of the window that jump straight to the chat or the channel list when you press Tab.

sounds.joinLeave: Someone joins or leaves your channel
sounds.voiceJoin: You join a channel for voice
sounds.kicked: You are kicked from a server
sounds.banned: You are banned from a server
sounds.messages: New message in a followed channel or private chat
sounds.partyStarted: Someone starts a watch party in your channel
sounds.shareStarted: Someone starts a screen share in your channel
sounds.shareStopped: A screen share in your channel ends
sounds.viewerStarted: Someone starts watching your screen share
sounds.viewerStopped: Someone stops watching your screen share

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.explanation: For new messages in your channel, followed channels and private chats, except the chat you are looking at.
notifications.inApp: In-app: a small pop-up inside Mumcord while it is in front
notifications.both: Both: pop-up while Mumcord is in front, system notification otherwise

inGame.title: In-game overlay
inGame.explanation: Shows who is talking inside your games. It starts by itself when a game starts and only appears in games.
inGame.antiCheat: Some games with anti-cheat protection treat any overlay as cheating and may ban the account. Those games are off by default, even when this is On.
inGame.noGames: No games known yet. Games show up here once they are detected.
inGame.unsupported: The in-game overlay is not available on this system.
inGame.loadFailed: The in-game overlay settings could not be loaded.
inGame.saveFailed: The in-game overlay change could not be applied.

opengl.title: OpenGL games
opengl.explanation: Only needed for OpenGL games: paste into the game's Steam launch options.
opengl.label: Steam launch option
opengl.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the text and copy it by hand.

inGame.confirmMessage: Warning: {{game}} uses anti-cheat protection ({{reason}}). Overlays can be detected as cheating and your account may be banned. Mumcord is not responsible for that. Only continue if you accept this risk.

limits.libraryMissing: The in-game overlay is not available: its overlay library (libmumcord_overlay_layer.so) was not found next to Mumcord. Reinstall Mumcord to restore it.
limits.windowsFullscreen: Use borderless or windowed fullscreen in the game.
limits.macos: macOS does not support in-game overlays.

diagnostics.fileHint: Saves app version, system, audio devices, connection statistics and recent log lines to a file you can share when reporting a problem. It contains no chat messages, passwords, certificates or personal data.

about.changelogFailed: The “What's new” window could not be opened.
about.noticesHint: Mumcord is built on open-source software, including code from the Mumble project.
about.noticesFailed: The third-party licences could not be opened.
about.devToolsUnlocked: Developer tools unlocked: the packet inspector is now in the settings list.
about.setupWizardHint: Go through the first-start setup again to review your microphone, privacy choices, update check and talk mode. Your current choices are filled in.
about.setupWizardIdentityNote: Your identity is not part of this. Your certificate, and with it your registered name and permissions on servers, stays exactly as it is.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sendToNewHint: Sent once, the first time you connect to a server where you have no avatar yet. Never sent again to that server, even if you change or remove your avatar there.
profile.skipped: Your default avatar was not sent: it is too large for this server.

linkPreviews.title: Link previews
linkPreviews.hint: Mumcord loads linked pages to show previews and video players; those sites see your IP address.

nowPlaying.title: Now playing
nowPlaying.hint: Mumcord reads the current track from your system's media player (for example Spotify) – no Spotify login needed. Other Mumcord users see title, artist, cover and progress; official Mumble clients see a "🎵 Artist – Title" line at the end of your comment.
nowPlaying.unsupported: Not supported on macOS: the system offers no way for apps to read the current track.

previewCache.title: Cached previews
previewCache.hint: Link previews, thumbnails and external images are kept on this computer so they load faster. Old ones are removed automatically.

cache.title: Cache
cache.hint: Mumcord keeps temporary data on this computer so things load faster. Clearing it is safe; it is rebuilt when needed.
cache.confirm: Only the selected caches are deleted. Your chat history, settings, servers, certificates, friends and notes are not touched.
cache.webPending: The web engine cache is removed the next time Mumcord starts.

nowGaming.title: Now gaming
nowGaming.hint: Mumcord looks for well-known games among your running programs and for the game Steam is running. Other Mumcord users see the game, its picture and how long you have been playing, and can join your server when the game offers one; official Mumble clients see a "🎮 Game" line at the end of your comment.

positional.title: Positional audio
positional.hint: Voices of people in the same game are placed around you in 3D. Needs a game that shares its positions.
positional.invalid: Enter distances in metres: minimum at least 0, maximum at least 1 above the minimum and at most 1000.
positional.betaHint: Results depend on the game and its plugin support.

gamePlugins.title: Positional audio: sources
gamePlugins.explanation: Games tell Mumcord where you are through Mumble Link or through official Mumble game plugins. Mumcord finds the plugins in its own plugin folder and in an existing Mumble installation. Turn on only the plugins for games you play.
gamePlugins.antiCheat: Game plugins read the game's memory. Some anti-cheat systems may flag this; turn plugins off for games with strict anti-cheat.
gamePlugins.none: No game plugins found. Install Mumble or copy plugin files into Mumcord's plugin folder.
gamePlugins.loadFailed: The game plugins could not be listed.
gamePlugins.switchFailed: The game plugin could not be switched.

problem.failed: Stopped after an error. Turn it off and on again to retry.

servers.limitHint: Between 1 and 15. Connecting beyond the limit is refused.
servers.limitInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 15.

appearanceEffects.title: Effects
appearanceEffects.visualEffectsHint: Frosted-glass menus and a subtle film grain. Turned off automatically when your system asks for reduced transparency or motion.

channelList.title: Channel list
channelList.weakConnectionHint: A small signal icon next to people whose connection is poor.

p2p.title: Peer-to-peer (screen sharing, full-size images)
p2p.explanation: Direct shows your IP address to the other person. The relay hides it from them; the relay's operator (this server's community) can see it. Both are end-to-end encrypted.
p2p.overrideHint: Only for this server. "Use global setting" follows Settings → Privacy.

mode.relayFirst: Direct + relay (always relay, hides my IP)

privacyDirect.title: Direct connections
privacyDirect.allow: Allow direct connections to other Mumcord users
privacyDirect.hint: Direct connections are faster, but the other person can see your IP address. Until you decide, Mumcord asks the first time one would be used.
privacyDirect.notUsed: Not used in the chosen peer-to-peer mode: Mumcord never connects directly to other people.

appImageMenu.label: Add Mumcord to the app menu
appImageMenu.hint: Makes the icon and push-to-talk work properly on Wayland and lets mumble:// links open Mumcord. Only for the AppImage.
appImageMenu.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

inspector.intro: Shows the packets Mumcord sends and receives, mainly Mumcord plugin data, for debugging. Only the last 2,000 packets are kept, in memory on this device; nothing is logged or sent anywhere.
inspector.devToolsHint: Turn off to hide the packet inspector again and stop capturing.
inspector.paused: Paused: new packets show up when you resume.
inspector.keepCapturingHint: Capture normally stops and is cleared when this window closes. Turn on to keep collecting packets while it is closed.
inspector.keepCapturingOn: Capture continues after this window is closed.
inspector.exportWarning: Exports contain the packets shown with the current filters and can include personal data such as names and chat text. Check them before sharing.
inspector.noDecoding: This payload has no readable form; see the raw bytes.
inspector.controlOnly: Standard Mumble message: only its type and size are recorded.

licences.title: Third-party licences
licences.own: Mumcord itself is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 only (AGPL-3.0-only).
licences.loadFailed: The licence list could not be loaded.

changelog.title: Mumcord {{version}}
changelog.subtitle: See what changed in each version. Newest first.
changelog.loadFailed: The changelog could not be loaded.
changelog.englishNote: The changelog is written in English.

dnd.title: Do Not Disturb
dnd.label: Do Not Disturb
dnd.description: No notification sounds or banners on any server. Voice and chat keep working, and unread badges keep counting.
dnd.followDescription: Turns Do Not Disturb on whenever your desktop's Do Not Disturb or Focus mode is on.
dnd.detectedOn: {{desktop}} · Do Not Disturb is on (system). Changes are picked up live.
dnd.detectedOff: {{desktop}} · Do Not Disturb is off. Changes are picked up live.
dnd.unavailableText: Mumcord can't read your system's Do Not Disturb state here. Only its own switch works.

privateMessages.title: Private messages
privateMessages.everyoneHint: Anyone on a server can message you.
privateMessages.friendsOnlyHint: Other Mumcord users can send a chat request instead. Messages from standard clients go to “Message requests”.
privateMessages.nobodyHint: No private messages and no chat requests are shown. Senders are not told.
privateMessages.keepRequests: Keep messages from standard clients as message requests
privateMessages.keepRequestsHint: Only used with “Friends only”. When off, these messages are dropped.
privateMessages.currentChannelHint: Overrides “Friends only” and “Nobody” while we are in the same channel.
privateMessages.acceptedHint: People whose chat request you accepted can keep writing to you.

blocked.title: Blocked users
blocked.hint: Blocks are kept on this computer only. Blocked users are muted for you and their messages and Mumcord data are ignored.
blocked.collapseHint: Shows “Message from a blocked user” with a Show button.
blocked.hideHint: Nothing is shown in the chat.

install.appImageReadOnly: an AppImage in a read-only folder
install.otherMac: a macOS copy outside an app bundle

updates.modeHint: Updates are always checked and verified before they are installed.
updates.autoUnavailable: This copy cannot update itself, so Mumcord only tells you about new versions.
updates.intervalWeekHint: On start and once a week

state.ready: Mumcord {{version}} is ready. Restart to update.
state.failed: The last update did not work
state.offline: GitHub could not be reached. Mumcord tries again later.

updates.checkFailed: The check could not be started. Please try again.
updates.skippedHint: {{version}} is skipped and will not be offered again.
updates.whatsNewHint: See the changes in every version.
